column1: # Fix and keep cases of rules.tsv. input is kir text (src/kir_text.h); level is the utterance level, or narr.
# A fix case must fire its rule and generate expected; a keep case must not fire it and generate expected. A case runs
# with its rule alone; rules that only work together are named a+b (both on, the case is about b).
